The US Federal Reserve has held interest rates steady as expected after three consecutive cuts last year. But Chairman Jerome Powell avoided questions about his claims that President Trump is putting pressure on him to cut rates.

Al Jazeera’s Shihab Rattansi reports.

description:
The UN Security Council held its regularly scheduled quarterly meeting on the situation in the Middle East, including the Palestinian question. Much of the discussion focused on stage two of the ceasefire agreement in Gaza. 

Al Jazeera’s Gabriel Elizondo reports from the United Nations.
